CustomField.description: PacPoint-IC051319 - Created for BREG phase 1 This is used on the Timeframe field calculation. If today is greater than the start date, count the months passed. If not, pass -1 value.
CustomField.formula: IF( TODAY() >= DATEVALUE( StartDate__c ), ( FLOOR(((TODAY() - DATEVALUE( StartDate__c )) / 365 * 12)) ), -1)
CustomField.label: Timeframe Count Months
